purpose: Starts each heavy job class through the real entry points, with and without a yes and at high usage, and checks no path bypasses the warning and the yes.
title: Heavy jobs cannot start without a warning and a yes

testCases.description: Each kind of big job is warned of and starts only on a yes for that job; no other way round the gate
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/heavy-job-gate.test.js::a big job of each kind (deep research, building an app, building a site, video and audio work) is warned of and starts only on the owner's yes for that job, and no other way of starting it gets round the gate

testCases.description: Above 90% in either window a big job needs a second yes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/heavy-job-gate.test.js::above 90% in either usage window a big job starts only on a second yes; below it one yes starts it

testCases.description: A small job below the big-job thresholds is free through the same floor, calm and busy
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/named-subagents.test.js::a small job below the big-job thresholds goes through the same floor and is free, with the plan calm and with both windows above every threshold

testCases.description: Through the floor as the laid settings run it, a big job is warned of, starts on the owner's yes, and the same yes does not start it a second time
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/heavy-job-gate.test.js::through the safety floor as Squire's session runs it (the settings lay-down writes in Squire's config folder), a big job is warned of, starts on the owner's yes for it, and the same yes does not start it a second time
